description: Normal shutter points to the custom PCM slot. Both old duplicate-boot aliases point to the retained original mono boot sound. Long-exposure opening, focus and other sound resources remain original.

patches.note: Normal shutter slot +8 in 0xc140e96c uses the custom sound at 0x62102c; do not redirect long-exposure opening slot +4.
Preserve sound index 1 as the original boot audio via its existing mono duplicate, before reusing the stereo duplicate storage.
Preserve the duplicate pointer table's sound index 1 as the original boot audio; all other table entries unchanged.
